feature: Correct actual video content after small Jellyfin seeks by isolating progressive cache generations
user_evidence: User reports one Left/Right tap resumes roughly the same scene. Uploaded log shows stream restarts without decoder errors; old build did not record network seek targets. Raw log and private paths are not published.
root_cause: Official Jellyfin10.10.7 GetOutputFilePath hashes media/UserAgent/device/PlaySessionId but not StartTimeTicks. StopEncodingProcess starts asynchronous cleanup; progressive output deletion is delayed1500ms. Reusing the filename can reopen old pictures, later delete the restarted output and make rebased client timestamps appear correct.

changes.cache_identity: Every restarted media request replaces/inserts one bounded User-Agent with a monotonic64bit generation. This changes the server output-cache key while preserving authentication/device/logical playback session. Update is atomic, no header growth or credential logging.
changes.seek_bounds: Network EOF margin0.5s matches the server clamp; local0.1s retained. Left/Right still10second steps. Diagnostic log reports accepted network seek times and generation only, never private HTTP requests.
changes.tests: Source frame number encoded into11 luma bars, with a300frame input GOP. Actual decoded pixels compared against fractional/one-second/ten-second forward/back/return/EOF targets.12wall-clock seconds of continuous source-content/clock agreement after final seek; delayed cleanup fixture and official server.
changes.retained: 0.47 media inactivity/audio timestamp/numbered-label fixes, local byte seeking, source scanning and settings preserved; no migration. Codec kernels, workers, GPU and PCM functions byte-identical.
